name: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Limited

facts.business: Canara Robeco Asset Management Company Limited operates as an asset management company managing mutual fund schemes and providing offshore advisory services.
key_risks: Inherent risks in computation of management fees due to manual input of key contractual terms and computation of applicable assets under management (AUM), which could result in errors.

Multiple schemes require effective monitoring over key financial terms and conditions being captured and applied accurately; any discrepancy could result in misstatement of management fee and advisory fee recognised in the financial statements.
